mechanisms.name: dislocation motion hindering by annealing twins

evidence.quote: Annealing twins serves to refine the grains, thereby hindering dislocation motion and generating work hardening, leading to high ductility.

mechanisms.name: stress concentration at coarse lamellar BCC phase

evidence.quote: coarse lamellar BCC phase precipitated in A900 alloy promotes stress concentration, causing a decline in ductility

mechanisms.name: work hardening by low lattice misfit precipitates

evidence.quote: The higher work-hardening rate of precipitation-strengthened LHEAs is mainly due to the low lattice misfit precipitates restricting dislocations movement and/or acting as a dislocation emission source, further promoting the dislocation density increase.
